name: Ghost Signal
description:
A starship telemetry relay has returned to service after an unexplained visit. The box is on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts use 172.20.0.141-199. Reconstruct what happened and recover the evidence left on the relay.

---

**Access** — SSH `root@172.20.0.141`, password `relay-archive-42`

tasks.name: Recover the relay evidence
tasks.description: Investigate the telemetry relay on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts use 172.20.0.141-199. Reconstruct the suspicious activity and recover the evidence it left behind.
hints: Compare the login records with the accounts and activity you find on the relay.
Follow the account associated with the unusual successful session and inspect its scheduled activity.
One scheduled command contains encoded data; decode that data to recover the evidence.
